reason: A DSH plugin for monitoring OpenCode GO quota windows and aggregating local session usage by model, with dashboard visualizations and refreshable usage indicators.

summaries.zh: 在 DSH 中展示 OpenCode GO 的账户额度、模型 Token 用量、估算费用和近期开销趋势。
summaries.en: Displays OpenCode GO account quotas, per-model token usage, estimated costs, and recent spending trends in DSH.

capabilities: Fetches account usage percentages from an external OpenCode usage endpoint using a bearer key
Reads local DSH session logs to aggregate model token usage and estimated costs
Displays quota status, usage trends, and refreshable indicators in the DSH interface
